snippet.title: Cinderia - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cinderia is available now in Early Access.
Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214610/_Cinderia/

Discord: https://discord.gg/RVTzJkg4F9

Cinderia is a fast-paced action roguelite where your build reshapes the way you fight.
Combine skills, passives, combos, and equipment to create a combat style that is entirely your own.

Every run changes your rhythm, your timing, and your approach to combat.

In a world reduced to ash by a witch's fire, only a few can wield corrupted magic without losing themselves.
You are one of them.

Features

• 4 playable characters, each with distinct mechanics
• 180+ skills and upgrades
• 130+ equipment items
• Endless build combinations
• Dozens of random events and room types

Continuous updates throughout Early Access

#Cinderia #Roguelite #ActionRoguelite #Steam
